children.value: > Fact From Story Republicans dropped Rep. Jim Jordan on Friday as their nominee for House speaker, making the decision during a closed-door session after the hard-edged ally of Donald Trump failed badly on a third ballot for the gavel.
> > Fact From Story Afterward, Jordan said simply of his colleagues, “We put the question to them, they made a different decision.”
> > Commonsense Knowledge If someone makes a different decision, it means they came to a different conclusion. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge When someone is dropped, they are no longer a candidate.
